_doc: Generated by tools/generate_bank_versions.py from a -DBUILD_TUNING=ON build; do not edit by hand. Each unit is a voice, a drum note or a group of shared calibration constants, carrying the generation it is on, a fingerprint of its values and the history of its bumps. `make bank-versions-check` fails when a unit's values have moved without its version following. It fingerprints values only: an edit to an engine's code moves nothing here, and the synth golden manifests under tests/midi/golden/ are what catch that. The values are here so the diff of a bump says what moved.

the bowed string gained a note-on excitation seed; kAttackSeed sets its depth and the patch field is 0 on every shipped voice, so nothing renders differently. The same generation dropped twelve family fallback patches no program or builder reaches -- a removed unit leaves no history entry of its own, so this is the only record of it inside the registry. What verified the twelve are unreferenced is an enumeration of every index into the family table across all five call sites, which come in two forms: family_patches()[i] in gm_fallback_map.cpp and fam[i] in the three program builders. Every index tree-wide is 0, 3, 4 or 7. The golden manifests cannot settle it on their own -- they render bank 0, and the builder in gm_fallback_programs_variations.h resolves outside that bank, so a variation reaching a removed slot would move no row
